title: Yav Package Manifest (package.yavml)
description: Central project configuration manifest for the Yav web framework

package.description: Project identity, versioning, and package metadata

name.description: Application package name (must be a valid identifier)

description.description: Short one-line description of the application

authors.description: List of project authors in 'Name <email>' format

repository.description: URL to the source code repository (e.g. GitHub)

keywords.description: List of search tags and keywords

server.description: HTTP runtime server settings loaded automatically by YavApp::new()

port.description: Port to bind the HTTP server to (default: 3000)

host.description: Host address to bind to (e.g. "127.0.0.1" or "0.0.0.0")

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate PEM file

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key PEM file

tailwind.description: Tailwind CSS standalone CLI integration (no Node.js required)

enabled.description: Enable automated Tailwind CSS compilation and watching

output.description: Compiled and purged CSS file destination

motion.description: Motion & Animation engine configuration (yav-motion with native WAAPI)

reduced_motion.description: Accessibility policy for animations: "user" respects OS settings, "always" disables motions, "never" forces motions

pwa.description: Progressive Web App (PWA) configuration for installable apps and offline support

enabled.description: Enable PWA manifest and service worker capabilities

name.description: Full application name shown on install prompts

short_name.description: Short app name for mobile launcher tiles

theme_color.description: Browser address bar and title bar theme color

display.description: PWA window display mode (standalone hides browser chrome)

start_url.description: Entry point URL when launched from app icon

build.description: Production compilation and asset distribution options

minify.description: Minify CSS and static templates in release mode

fingerprint.description: Append content hashes (styles.a1b2c3d4.css) for immutable caching

dependencies.description: Yav plugins, components, and feature packages

scripts.description: Named project command shortcuts (e.g. dev, build, test)

fonts.description: External Google Fonts or local font stylesheet URLs

static_dirs.description: Additional static directories copied to production dist
